candidates.title: Last Stand Clutch Mode
candidates.why: HP below 15% currently reads the same as HP at 50% — the danger drone gets louder but nothing visceral happens. Adding a 90-frame automatic Last Stand state (deep red vignette, setDangerIntensity(1.0), 'LAST STAND!' floating text) transforms near-death from anxiety into a legendary clutch window. Every close-call run becomes shareable.
candidates.recipe: In App.jsx game loop, track gs.lastStandActive: set true when gs.player.health < gs.player.maxHealth * 0.15 and reset when health recovers or player dies. In drawGame.js add a full-screen deep red radial gradient at alpha 0.28 when gs.lastStandActive. Emit setDangerIntensity(1.0) and addText 'LAST STAND!' on state entry.

candidates.title: Kill-Chain Audio Escalation
candidates.why: The combo counter climbs to 20+ but soundEnemyDeathAt plays the same flat tone at combo 1 vs combo 15. Pitching each kill sound up by +80 cents per 5-combo tier and adding a bass impact thud at chain 10+ makes combos feel physically real. The existing kill sound uses Web Audio API oscillators — this is a one-parameter pass-through change.
candidates.recipe: Pass comboRef.current.count to soundEnemyDeathAt (or create soundEnemyDeathAtCombo). In sounds.js: at combo ≥5 add +80 cents detune; at combo ≥10 add second oscillator +1 octave; at combo ≥15 add short sub-bass thump. Add RAMPAGE/GODLIKE/UNSTOPPABLE floating text milestones at 5/10/15 with escalating colors (#FF6400, #FF0088, #FFD700).

candidates.title: Adaptive Soundtrack Situational Layers
candidates.why: The heat-meter drives the base music tier but there are no situational audio overlays — the same tier-2 track plays whether the player is at full health cruising or at 5HP fighting a Phase 2 boss. A synthesized heartbeat bass pulse at HP<15% and a rising string swell when a boss hits <10% HP would make these moments feel cinematic and zero-cost (pure Web Audio synthesis).
candidates.recipe: In sounds.js add soundLastStandHeartbeat() — low 60bpm sine pulse with a slight reverb tail, volume scales inversely with health fraction. Add soundBossFinaleLayer() — a brief rising sawtooth chord (220→440Hz over 1.5s). In App.jsx: on health entering <15% call soundLastStandHeartbeat(); on boss health crossing 10% call soundBossFinaleLayer(). Store refs so they can be stopped on health recovery or boss death.

candidates.title: Live Pace Coaching Chip in HUD
candidates.why: The HUD shows current wave but has no personal context — a player at wave 15 doesn't know if they're ahead or behind their best run. A small 'PACE: W18 PB' chip that turns green/yellow/red creates a live personal challenge without any server calls. RunBrain already loads career stats locally; this is a pure display layer over existing data.
candidates.recipe: In HomeV2/App.jsx load career bestWave from loadCareerStats() before game start and pass as bestWave prop to HUD. In HUD.jsx render a PACE chip: compute projectedFinalWave from (currentWave/timeSurvived * estimatedRunTime); show AHEAD/ON PACE/BEHIND vs bestWave with green/yellow/red border. Only shown wave ≥3, only if bestWave > 0.

candidates.title: Phantom Elite Enemy Variant
candidates.why: The four existing elite variants (armored/fast/berserker/explosive) all modify stats but none change visual tracking difficulty. A phantom variant that pulses between 20% and 100% opacity every 1.5s creates a genuine skill-based tracking challenge — players must predict its location during cloaked frames. The drawGame elite rendering already handles special ring styles, and applyEliteType covers the spawn path.
candidates.recipe: Add 'phantom' to the eliteType options in gameHelpers.js getRandomEliteType (wave ≥25 only). In applyEliteType: set e.phantomTimer = 0, e.phantomVisible = true, e.speed *= 1.1, e.health *= 0.85. In drawGame.js enemy render: if e.eliteType === 'phantom', compute opacity = e.phantomVisible ? 1 : 0.15 + Math.sin(timeNow/200)*0.05, apply ctx.globalAlpha. In game loop: every frame tick e.phantomTimer++; every 90 frames toggle e.phantomVisible.

candidates.title: Weekly Rival Ghost Overlay
candidates.why: topGhosts loads from the leaderboard and appears on HUD but there's no WEEKLY champion ghost that creates persistent rivalry pressure. Querying the leaderboard for ts > 7 days ago and loading the top result as a weekly rival would mean every session players see 'BEHIND THE_DESTROYER +3 WAVES' in the HUD — social pressure without authentication or friends lists.
candidates.recipe: In storage.js add loadWeeklyTopGhost() — queries Supabase leaderboard filtered by ts > Date.now()-7d, selects top score, caches in sessionStorage for 1h. In HomeV2/App.jsx call it at game start and store as weeklyRivalRef. Pass weeklyRival to HUD alongside topGhosts. In HUD render: 'WEEKLY RIVAL: [name]' chip with BEATING/BEHIND delta vs current wave/score.

candidates.title: Death Recap Mini-Replay on Death Screen
candidates.why: Ghost data is already stored in sessionStorage as {x,y,f} frames — the death screen only uses it as a static path drawing. Animating the final 8 seconds of ghost movement as a short auto-playing replay on the death screen canvas (at 2x speed, 4-second playback) would transform the death screen from a static summary into a dramatic cinematic recap. This is a pure canvas animation layer over already-stored data.
candidates.recipe: In DeathScreen.jsx, after ghost canvas renders the static path, start a requestAnimationFrame loop that replays the last N ghost frames (8s × 60fps = ~480 frames) at 2x speed. Draw player dot + trail, fade-in the final kill marker at end. Add a 'REPLAY' button to restart the animation. No new data required — existing ghostData.frames slice is enough.

candidates.title: Deterministic Replay Resim Runner (Phase 2B)
candidates.why: Deterministic replay resim is the highest-trust feature in the backlog — it would let submit-score prove a submitted run is reachable from stored trace inputs. All the primitives are in place: gameStep.js for movement, combatResolution.js for hit math, flowField.js for pathing, and replayCommandTrace.js for input encoding. The only missing piece is a headless runner that seeds the RNG from runSeed and applies stored commands frame by frame.
candidates.recipe: Create src/utils/replayResim.js: export runResim(seed, traceBody, maxFrames) that initializes gs from seed, decodes the command trace, applies each frame via gameStep/combatResolution, and returns {finalWave, finalScore, driftPct}. Wire into validate-replay Edge Function as Phase 2B: if traceBody present, run resim and reject if driftPct > 2%.
